blocks.html: Robinsons Place Iligan, the 45th shopping mall of Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) will be formally opened on Wedensday, July 26 at 2 pm. PBB All-In Grand Winner and I Can Do That 3rd Placer, Daniel Matsunaga, will be one of the special guests in the event. Hon. Celso Regencia, Mayor of Iligan City, will commence the event by leading the ribbon cutting ceremony together with Msgr. Jemar Vera Cruz, Vice Mayor of Iligan City and Ms. Justin Mae San Jose, Mutya ng Pilipinas 2016. Ms. Arlene Magtibay, RLC’s Gen. Manager for Commercial Centers Division, is scheduled to be on hand to offer a few remarks regarding the opening of its 6th mall in the Mindanao region and to assist in the ribbon cutting ceremony.
